backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a poetry platform managing poems, collections, user profiles, and notifications with role-based access control (admin/user), draft mode toggling, and blob storage support.
backend/migration.mo: Stub migration module defining old and new actor state types with a no-op `run` function to transform state between versions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three admin UI features (login modal, access-restricted controls, delete poem) to their implementing files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary document describing the purpose of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file setting up Tailwind base/components/utilities and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' and mounts the React app via `/src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, poem detail, admin form, admin panel, and collections, wrapped in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider.
Modal dialog component for admin password login that calls `useAdminAuth.login`, shows/hides password, displays errors, and closes on success.
Route guard component that renders children only when `isAdminMode` is true, otherwise shows an access-denied screen with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with a sticky header containing navigation links, admin mode controls, mobile menu, login button, and notification bell. Renders child routes via an Outlet.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading, authenticated, or unauthenticated states.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBell: Bell icon button that displays an unread notification count badge and opens a NotificationPanel popover on click.
frontend/src/components/NotificationPane: Scrollable panel listing user notifications with timestamps, showing unread items highlighted and providing a button to mark each as read.
frontend/src/components/PoemCard.tsx: Card component displaying a poem (image or text) with navigation to the poem detail page, collection assignment dialog, and admin delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to enter their name to complete profile setup, blocking interaction until saved.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Hook managing admin session state via sessionStorage with a hardcoded password, exposing login, logout, and isAdminMode values.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing identity, login/clear functions, and login status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend operations including fetching poems/collections, searching, and mutations for submitting, updating, deleting poems, and managing collections.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS, and defines CSS custom properties for warm earth-tone light and dark color themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminForm.tsx: Admin page form for submitting new poems (text or image type) with title, author, content, image upload, and collection assignment, guarded by AdminRouteGuard.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that displays the current draft/live status of the app and provides a confirmation dialog to publish to production.
frontend/src/pages/CollectionManager.tsx: Admin page for creating and deleting collections, and removing poems from collections, with a list view of existing collections and their associated poems.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home page displaying all poems with search, debounced filtering, and collection-based filtering via clickable collection badges.
frontend/src/pages/PoemDetail.tsx: React page component that displays a single poem's details, supporting download (image or generated PNG), adding to collections, and admin-only edit/delete actions with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/utils/downloadHelpers.ts: Utility functions for triggering browser file downloads from a URL, a Blob, and for sanitizing filenames.
frontend/src/utils/formatDate.ts: Converts a nanosecond-precision backend Time value to a human-readable 'Month Day, Year' date string.
frontend/src/utils/poemImageGenerator.ts: Generates a styled 1200×1600 PNG image of a poem using the HTML Canvas API, including title, content, author, and branding, then returns it as a Blob.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (using oklch variables), typography, border radius, box shadows, font families, and animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the app's architecture, existing implemented features, known issues, and pending feature requests for a poetry collection app with password-protected admin access.
